### Downloads

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `EarPair-0.2.2-win-x64-setup.exe` | The Windows app for most PCs. Run it to install. |
| `EarPair-0.2.2-win-arm64-setup.exe` | The same for Arm PCs. |
| `EarPair-0.2.2-macos-universal.dmg` | The Mac app, for Intel and Apple silicon. Open it and drag `EarPair` to Applications. |

### What's new

- Spatial audio with AirPods. On the Mac's new Spatial Audio page, face the Mac's screen and then the PC's once. After that the PC's sound comes from the PC's screen and the Mac's from the Mac's, and both stay put as you turn your head; the one you look away from moves aside and gets quieter (adjustable). It pauses while the PC isn't sending and picks up again when it's back. Needs AirPods or other headphones with head tracking; moving the Mac's own sound needs macOS 14.2 or later. EarPair asks for motion data and system audio recording the first time.
- The Mac app now updates itself. From this version on, EarPair checks for new versions and installs them with one click in the menu bar. Version 0.2.1 can't do this yet, so download this one by hand.
- The Windows app is unchanged apart from the version number.

### 更新内容

- AirPods 空间音频。在 Mac 新的“空间音频”页里，脸先正对 Mac 屏幕、再正对电脑屏幕各一次。之后电脑的声音从电脑屏幕那边来，Mac 的声音从 Mac 那边来，转头时都待在原处；没在看的那台移到一边、小一些（可以调）。电脑停止发送时暂停，回来后自动继续。需要支持头部追踪的 AirPods 或其他耳机；Mac 自己的声音跟着转需要 macOS 14.2 或更新。第一次用时会询问运动数据和系统录音权限。
- Mac 版可以自动更新了。从这个版本起，EarPair 会自己检查新版本，在菜单栏点一下就能装好。0.2.1 还没有这个功能，这次请手动下载。
- Windows 版除了版本号没有变化。
